scope_label: supplier outputs, controls and performance for an intended relationship
definition: Supplier quality is how well a supplier’s outputs and relevant processes meet the requirements of an intended customer relationship.
explanation: Assessment may consider delivered conformity, consistency, process controls, timeliness, and response when problems occur. The importance of each depends on the purchased item or service and the consequences of failure.
A single delivery score cannot establish the quality of every supplier activity. State the requirements, period, and evidence behind the judgment.
